definition: Ruslan Salakhutdinov (Russian: Руслан Салахутдинов; born c. 1980) is an Uzbek researcher working in the field of artificial intelligence.
details: Pioneered Deep Boltzmann Machines, Dropout, and Bayesian deep learning alongside Geoffrey Hinton, and led Apple's foundational AI research. He specializes in deep learning, probabilistic graphical models, and large-scale optimization.

explainer.lead: Ruslan Salakhutdinov is a Canadian AI researcher. His work spans deep learning and artificial intelligence.
explainer.knownFor: He is well known for having developed Bayesian Program Learning.

timeline.what: Bachelor of Science, High Point University
Master of Science, University of Toronto
Doctor of Philosophy, University of Toronto
Postdoctoral researcher at Massachusetts Institute of Technology (until 2011)
Assistant professor at University of Toronto (until 2016)
